Devon: hey folks - quick onboarding/payroll questions after benefits enroll
Devon: 1) i never got a digital ID for my carrier and my dermatologist appt is tomorrow. is a screenshot OK?
Sasha (People Ops): welcome Devon! screenshot of the member page usually works. we can also issue a temporary eligibility letter if needed. DM me provider name and appt time and i'll generate it.
Devon: provider: UrbanDerm, appt 2026-04-05 9:15am
BenefitsBot: Enrollment status: Devon (emp 18350) - carrier verification pending (est 24-48 hrs).
Devon: 2) i uploaded relocation invoices to Concur but it still shows "pending approval". timeline?
Finance: relocation expenses route People Ops -> Finance. Typical processing is 2 payroll cycles after approval. If you need faster, submit a ticket to finance-ops with subject "EXPEDITE-RELO" and include the Concur link.
Devon: thanks. last Q: payroll portal shows PTO 0 even though i should have prorated days for March start (3/10). who fixes this?
Payroll: prorated initial PTO posts after onboarding completion (usually within 3 business days). If it doesn't appear by EOD Friday, reply here and we'll investigate.
Devon: perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
